description: This file defines the ParamRule class in the OrangeHRM Core API validation module, representing validation rules for a specific parameter including its key, rules, default value, and composite logic.

classes.name: ParamRule
classes.description: Represents a validation rule set for a specific parameter, including rules, default value, and composite logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ParamRule with a parameter key and one or more rules.

methods.name: getParamKey
methods.description: Returns the parameter key associated with this rule.

methods.name: getRules
methods.description: Retrieves the list of rules associated with this parameter.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Sets the list of rules for this parameter.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default value for the parameter.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Sets the default value for the parameter.

methods.name: getCompositeClass
methods.description: Gets the composite class used to combine rules (e.g., ALL_OF, ONE_OF).

methods.name: setCompositeClass
methods.description: Sets the composite class for rules; throws ValidatorException for invalid input.
